V2 differences from resident-only v1:
- Remove standalone-only and kv_resident0 guards. Ordinary phase0 --serve with context262144/resident32768 now has a source execution path. Require no prompt/conversation cache/save, split/helper/MTP/pipeline/vision/borrow/adaptive/elastic/growing KV. Require explicit positive --vram-reserve-mib, fixed --prefill, and serve --short-read0. Disable short-read Verifier substitutions so the complete fresh conditioning span is one run_layer_major call; checkpoint root/message/turn/pin cuts are absent because capacities are zero and pin refused. Raw --spec4 permitted; no rawspec1 restriction was added.
- Server accepts ordinary GEN/QUIT only. After parse, refuse images/pin/PCIe tuning, missing prompt, nonfinite/tainted previous state, actuallive/checkpoint/parked/disk/slot state. Actualresume/from_live/incoming/slot source rechecked before sessionzero. Completed nonreusable token/image metadata cleared after ordinary decode completion; next GEN can reset and run again. One-token GEN uses ordinary token path without prefill. Defaultckpt metadata is harmless with zero capacity; periodic callback checkpoint predicate explicitly disabled when layer-major enabled.
- Configured R_GPU is a maximal prefix token budget (strict decimal0..262144). Clamp to actualn, then round down whole chunks; if alln fits include finalshortchunk. Requestedbudget/effectiveGPU/hostrows explicitly recorded. No fresh-VRAM-driven automatic shrink and no reserve reduction. Variable warm-up/long-request lengths can share one budget. V1 prefix>n refusal is superseded only by this intentional budget semantics.
- Public on_chunk retained/restored and invoked only for final-layer chunks after existing checked producercs completion. Intermediate internal callbacks write residualbridge only. No on_stage_chunk or intermediate checkpoints admitted. Ordinary server callback produces final-row PP progress/output; MTP and checkpoint branches are disabled. Callbacks must not create their own cross-layer snapshots because earlier layers may already be at requestend while final layer is at a chunkboundary.
- Original-entry ple_prev pair still reset before every layer; actual legitimate sessionzero sets it to[-1,-1] for every freshGEN, not a once-per-process condition. GlobalQSA/GDN ordinal/absoluteposition logic remains currentrun_impl.

Streamed-KV correctness design from R398, not runtime proof:
Current run_impl's kv_mode1 path still refreshes m.stage from canonical host prefix at EACHchunk, appends positions to host KV/currentresidentmap slots/identitystage, then selects/attends from identitystage. All remain ordered on current in-order m.cs. No new persistentstage or narrowed resident pool substituted. take_stage and identitytable allocation remain unchanged. Init admits modes0/1 and rejects mixed mode/page count/context acrossQSA; fullcontextstage built from primary QSA therefore covers every admitted QSA. No defaultstreaming mode or currentKV kernel changed. Actual stage/prefix/indexer/lastpartialchunk equality needs Main GPU qualification.

Owned normal stage_dev ring allocation and per-slot count are omitted. MMQ mring/gather/group buffers retained because residentMMQ compute can use them. HostStager/pinnedring/events/PLE ownership constructor/destructor/cancel paths retained. This is normal DEVICE expert staging-ring removal, not host-source or MMQ-ring deletion.
- run_impl before eachchunk checks ring0, oneactive-layer range, privatecache slots==actualexpertcount, exact fullresidency(e->slot e), sizedoffsetmonotonic and per-slotbytes>=actualcurrentlayerblob. Privatecache upload checks nonnullsource/destination and checkedcopy completion before residency publication.
- Audited source control flow: stream_all requires m.ring>STAGE, so ring0 selects routed path; threadedissuer=false and emptyseq prevents modulo/ring-window branches. Routed stage_one returns immediately forresidentexperts before stage_dev/STAGE stage assignment; job construction skipsresidents. Every activeexpert is protected by productioncapacityguard. Residentcompute reads cache directly or retainedMMQ gather buffers. StagerDone still drains/finishes existing sourceworkers. Missing expert/capacity refuses before any ring0 chunk kernel.
- No ring removal physicalsaving/fit measured. Actual count/carve consistency and finite pointer accesses must be built/tested. Current phasebytes count still includes streamedKVstage/currentalias regions/8MiBslack. Existingworkspace+head+state+decodecache charged beforefreshsampling; newall512cache+GPUprefix/RAMtail+operatorreserve still admitted. Exactcacheblob depends on actualpack, not a rounded historicalsize.

Existing session_zero/qsa_state_zero are void and ignore bool memset_async/copy_async submission results. A successful later queue drain alone cannot prove that a refused reset submission ran. To avoid claiming a realfreshGEN on stale state, v2 adds session_zero_checked and qsa_state_zero_checked alongside unchanged originalfunctions. They issue exactly the same zero/copy/map-reset operations and test each bool result; streamed kv_stream_reset submission exceptions are caught, and false/exception returnsfalse. Successfulqueue submission is not completion; caller still checksstream_sync. Both initialmodelsession and eachfreshGEN use these APIs ONLYwhen layermajorON. False result or drain failure triggers _Exit74/existingfailstop before model/session/residualowners unwind. Ordinary OFF uses unchanged originalfunctions. No numerical/kernel reset content changed.

Failedrequests notrolledback or reusable; nonfinite/tainted state rejected. Sourceexceptions/knownerrors unwind only aftercheckedguarddrains; unknowncopy/drain failsbeforeunwind.
